system.name: MAGNET
system.one_liner: Masked audio generation with a single non-autoregressive transformer that fills RVQ audio tokens over a few parallel decoding iterations, with external rescoring.

content.variant_note: the decoding loop (Restricted Transformer, Rescoring, Span Masking) unrolled over iterations 1, 2, 3 ... s, with a token grid that fills in
content.argues: Inference is a short loop: predict candidate tokens for masked spans, rescore them with an external model, re-mask the least confident spans, repeat until all tokens are fixed.
content.subject: Four decoding iterations of a masked token grid through a restricted transformer, rescoring and span masking, ending in an audio decoder and a waveform.

new_tags.name: iteration-columns
new_tags.what: an iterative procedure drawn as identical aligned columns for iterations 1, 2, 3 ... s with an ellipsis, and a return line handing each column's output to the next column's input

lessons.what_to_learn: Unroll an iterative decoding loop as identical aligned columns (iteration 1, 2, 3, ..., s) and let the cell colours of a toy token grid change from column to column so the grid visibly fills in; hand each column's output to the next with an orthogonal line and close the last column with the decoder and the output signal.
lessons.suits: Iterative or masked decoding, refinement and sampling loops whose state is a grid of discrete tokens.

evidence: During each iteration, we mask a subset of token spans (starting from a fully masked sequence).
at each iteration step, we fix the most probable token spans, i.e., the spans that got the top confidence score

summary: MAGNET is a masked generative model that produces audio tokens with a single non-autoregressive transformer over a few parallel decoding iterations, with an external pretrained model rescoring the predictions. Figure 1 draws inference as four aligned columns for iterations 1, 2, 3 and s. In each column a 4 x 6 grid of RVQ token ids, fully masked at first, goes up through a lilac Restricted Transformer to a grid of candidate tokens and a Rescoring box; an orthogonal line passes to a Span Masking box that feeds the next column. A T5 encoder and a quoted prompt condition the first transformer by cross attention, pink cells turn green over the iterations, and the last column ends in an EnCodec decoder and a waveform.
summary_zh: MAGNET 用单个非自回归 Transformer 并行迭代生成音频 token，并用外部模型重打分。图把推理画成解码迭代 1 到 s 的列：网格经受限 Transformer、重打分、片段掩码传下一列，末列经 EnCodec 出波形。
notes: The prior put model-anatomy first; the boxes are black boxes named by what they do and the figure draws a loop, so I put stage-pipeline first. The prior counted 4 panels; the iteration columns are not framed, so I record them as lanes. The pink and green cell meaning is read from how cells change between columns and from the paper's 'fix the most probable token spans'; it is not keyed in the figure. Whether the token ids are from a real run is not stated.
